instrument: xml calls ambiguity — every ambiguous `calls` edge enumerated with the key space the gate builds

ruling.question: does the edge's OWN FILE declare the callee? The resolver ranks own-file before anything else, so a collision the own file settles is determinate; one it does not is a genuine tie-break risk.
ruling.falsifier: any edge with declarationsInOwnFile === 0 falsifies 'determinate by own-file preference' — those edges are listed in full under noOwnFileDeclaration
